what: Work cards and portrait photos bend with skewY around the right center axis by the scroll speed — the target tilt is −per-frame speed × .25 clamped at ±10°, and the current tilt follows .12 of the remaining difference each frame, so when scrolling stops it smoothly straightens back to 0. Scrolling down tilts one way, scrolling up tilts the opposite way

options.gain: Tilt multiplier applied to speed (px per frame), default .25

from.where: index.html .jg-card (work card) · .jg-aboutd__portrait (portrait photo) — original skew: clamp ±10, −velocity × .25, lerp .12, transformOrigin right center, Lenis velocity

note: Even with several attached elements, the same tilt is shared by one tick (the original also uses a single quickSetter). The options of the last attached element apply to all
